what:

(shared core: ``tokenizers`` + readout_config.json) must give exactly the token ids, attention blocks, slots, state

tokenizer of the main repository) on every question of both fixtures, and score_many's shared-prefix rendering must
equal rendering each question alone.
note: runtime_sha256 is jev_style_decision_gguf.py; jev_style_decision_mlx.py contains the same shared core (rendering, readout, calibration, budgets, CLI) byte for byte (scripts/formats/build_runtimes.py asserts it)
